mapper.sql: select log_id, channel, receiver_id, target, business_type, business_id, title, status, error_msg, send_time, create_time from sys_notify_log
mapper.insert: insert into sys_notify_log (channel, receiver_id, target, business_type, business_id, title, status, error_msg, send_time, create_time) values (#{channel}, #{receiverId}, #{target}, #{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{title}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, #{sendTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: where business_type = #{businessType} and business_id = #{businessId} order by log_id desc
